caption:
Creators posted 35% more Reels. Reels reach fell 35% in the same period.

That's a 2026 Metricool study covering roughly one million accounts and 40 million posts, comparing 2025 to 2024. Overall post reach fell 31%.

Read it twice, because it kills the most common advice in this industry. "Just post more" was tested at scale by a million accounts. It did not work.

Here is what I think happened: everyone got told volume was the answer, everyone raised volume, the supply of content grew faster than the demand for it, and the share per post went down. You cannot out-post a feed that is already full.

What is left when volume is off the table is uncomfortable but short — a better first three seconds, a reason to send it, and an offer worth the click.

Post consistently. Just stop expecting the quantity itself to do the work.
